title: UN Commission finding on detainees used as human shields
summary: The Commission examined instances in which Palestinian detainees were placed ahead of Israeli military personnel or vehicles during operations.
claim: The Commission found that Israeli security forces used detainees as human shields in several instances in the West Bank and Gaza, including forcing detainees into tunnels and buildings ahead of military personnel.
legal_characterization: War-crime finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment or individual conviction.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 107 of A/79/232. The legal characterization is explicitly attributed to the Commission and does not assign criminal liability to a named individual.
